instances.claim: fix: skip ASR segments when length is zero
fix: 修复知乎 specified_id 和已有 Chrome CDP 连接问题
fix: make CompanyNews.author optional to handle missing API data
fix: citation/thinking prompts
Fix `detections_to_coco_annotations` function for empty polygons.
fix(postgres): make PGVectorStorage table/index creation idempotent (fixes #2702)
fix(parser): hash & shorten filenames that exceed filesystem limit
fix: append PID to log filename to prevent concurrent server collision
fix: update Hunyuan3D to Tencent Cloud AI3D API 3.0
fix(server): resolve /history 500 error by correcting importlib.resources usage
fix: respect BYPASS_ADMIN_ACCESS_CONTROL in file list/search endpoints
fix(msword): use outlineLvl for heading levels and clamp to minimum 1
fix(proxy): raise ValueError for unknown IP_PROXY_PROVIDER_NAME instead of crashing with AttributeError
fix: log API failures and handle missing data in Ben Graham agent
fix: ensure LLM stats tracking is accurate by including completed subagents
fix: make embedding API key optional for local OpenAI-compatible engines
fix(layoutir): restrict requires-python to >=3.12 to match layoutir dependency
fix: populate class_name in DetectionDataset annotations
fix(search): Handle currency as numeric
fix: close file handles in from_local() config loading
Fix UnboundLocalError for tokenizer in from_pretrained
fix(frontend): simplify onboarding logic and fix UI issues
Fix path_to_project_yml method to use config instead of removed constant
fix: sync bundled Hunyuan addon, harden zip import, bump 1.8.3
fix: Support new Spotify API response format (track -> item)
Fixes #21407: Enable Ruff isort rules for consistent import ordering
fix(cli): sync server language setting to local config after login
Fix typerror in `_update_priority` in scheduler.py
Fix spurious engine deprecation warning in write_image
fix: Incorrect hybrid search variable unpacking order

selection.candidate_order: merged_at ascending within repository, then round-robin by repository rank
selection.github_transport_retry: five attempts for URL/timeout failures with 1,2,4,8 second backoff

prior_corpus_exclusion.rule: exclude matching source_url before applying the per-repository cap

selection.pull_request_rule: first 100 GitHub results merged 2026-02-17..2026-08-31, sorted by updated ascending; exact case-insensitive bug label or title beginning fix/fixed/fixes/fixing
